# Security Evaluation Report: Parser Boundary Check

## Vulnerability Analysis
The analysis of `parser/bounds.py` reveals a boundary check mechanism that can be triggered by providing an input index that exceeds the allocated buffer size or falls outside the expected range of the parser's internal state.

## Evidence of Trigger
An input containing the value `REDACTED_TRIGGER` was found to bypass the initial validation logic, leading to an out-of-bounds access attempt within the parser's processing loop.

## Impact
Triggering this boundary check can lead to application instability or unexpected behavior when the parser attempts to access memory outside of its designated boundary.

## Recommendation
Implement strict input validation and use safe indexing methods to ensure that all boundary checks are enforced before memory access occurs.
